label: Six low-flashpoint fuels, each with how it is kept on board: LNG cold at minus 162 degrees, CNG compressed, LPG liquid under pressure, methanol and ethanol liquid at normal temperature, ammonia cold or under pressure, hydrogen compressed or cold.

parts.text:

the others: alternative design

steps.title: 1 · LNG - natural gas, liquid at about -162 °C
2 · CNG - natural gas compressed to high pressure
3 · LPG - propane and butane, kept liquid under pressure
4 · methanol and ethanol - liquids at normal temperature
5 · ammonia - liquid at -33 °C or under pressure; toxic
7 · The IGF Code covers them in different ways
